description:
Joining us on today’s Q&A program are Pastor Stephen Bohr and Pastor Daniel Miranda.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
.
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. (2:12) IF Satan knew God like no one else and still decided to rebel... What hope do we have? Often we ask God to help us in knowing Him, in knowing his will change us or save us... but satan tried that already and still he decided not to follow God? How can you see and be so close to such goodness and such glory and decide to get apart from it? It doesn't make sense. Please help me to understand this.
2. (7:10) Which Spanish concordance do you recommend Pastor Bohr?
3. (9:35) All I want to know is about the Godhead and Trinity. Could you explain to me this question? Are these words equal?
4. (19:28) 1 Cor 13 says love never ends... If you stop loving someone does it mean you never loved them? Is love a decision or a mindset/attitude or... What is it? If love is a decision can you decide to stop loving someone and still say that you loved them?
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
